question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing ‘4’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d569cc10a9335620916e47a4047879ed3496cc8976caf95fe632794d34f5d087.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes taking figure 1 and figure 3 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 1, 2, 3 and 4 are adjacent to it and remaining number i.e., 5 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac061f5d1cc311fa68f8d21a3229aae67bf41ee5df41fffacbef0064533526f3.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 3

2 → 4

5 → 6

So, the opposite side of "2" will be side "4".

Hence, the correct answer is "4".
